values./system/description:
The Ripper is a small, handheld, militarized chainsaw that saw extensive use in the armed conflicts before the Great War, with a commercial-grade, scaled-down version made available for the general market. It can saw through both flesh and metal alike with ease.

Rippers can accept one of the following mods which are installed with the Repair skill:

  • Ripper: Curved Blade, Extended Blade
